full_prompt_en: A square fine-art floral photograph shows two blue blossoms on slender dark stems against a softly mottled gray background. The larger flower opens across the upper left, with broad translucent petals bending outward and overlapping in uneven layers. Its cool blue surface has darker veining and soft wrinkles that radiate from a pale center. A ring of tiny golden-orange stamens surrounds a small green seedlike core. The second flower sits lower and farther right, angled downward toward the viewer. Its petals curl and fold more tightly, with one broad lobe extending toward the right edge. A matching golden center catches the light beneath the blue folds. Thin almost-black stems rise diagonally from the lower left, crossing near the middle before supporting the two heads. One small unopened bud hangs along the left stem. The rest of the background remains free of objects, changing gradually from warm gray at the top to cooler, darker blue-gray below. Very shallow depth of field keeps the stamens and near petal ridges sharp while allowing the far edges and background to soften. Diffuse light from the upper left passes through the thin petals, giving their ridges a luminous quality and leaving only mild shadows where they overlap. The orange centers act as small warm counterpoints to the cool petals, and the black stems supply a spare graphic structure. No vase, hand, or readable text is visible. The overall composition is airy and intimate, with two blooms of unequal height balanced by generous negative space and restrained blue-gold color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形艺术花卉照片呈现两朵蓝花，由纤细深色茎秆托起，背景是柔和斑驳的灰色。较大的花在左上展开，宽阔半透明花瓣向外弯曲，并不均匀地层层重叠。冷蓝表面有从浅色花心辐射出的较深叶脉和柔软皱褶。一圈细小金橙色雄蕊围住绿色种籽般的中心。第二朵花位于更低、更右处，向观者下倾。其花瓣卷曲并折得更紧，一片宽瓣伸向右缘。相似的金色中心在蓝色褶瓣下接住光。几根近黑色细茎从左下斜向升起，在中部附近交叉，托住两颗花头。一枚小小未开花苞垂在左侧茎上。其余背景没有物件，从上方暖灰逐渐转为下方更冷、更暗的蓝灰。很浅的景深使花蕊和近处花瓣脊线清楚，让远侧边缘与背景柔化。漫射光从左上穿过薄花瓣，使其脊线发亮，在互相遮挡处只留下轻影。橙色花心为冷花瓣提供小块暖色对位，黑茎则组成简洁图形结构。没有花瓶、手或可读文字。整体构图通透而亲密，以高低不等的两朵花、宽裕留白和克制蓝金配色形成平衡。
style_prompt_en: The fine-art photography isolates delicate translucent forms against a seamless, softly varied neutral field. Cool blue occupies the broadest light areas, while tiny warm gold accents draw attention to the structural center. Thin dark lines support larger ruffled shapes, producing a graceful contrast of scale and direction. Close focus preserves fine veins, ridges, and small clustered details, then dissolves smoothly into shallow background blur. Diffuse side light glows through thin surfaces rather than producing hard specular shine. Shadows stay gentle inside overlaps; the backdrop carries barely perceptible color drift instead of a defined environment. The overall effect is quiet and tactile, shaped by airy negative space, selective sharpness, and the exchange between cool transparent color and minute warm highlights.
style_prompt_zh: 这种艺术摄影把纤薄半透明形体隔离在无缝、柔和变化的中性底域前。冷蓝占据最大的亮区，微小暖金重音把注意引向结构中心。细深线支撑较大褶边形状，形成优雅的尺度与方向对比。近景焦点保留细脉、隆起纹和聚集小细节，随后平滑溶入浅景深背景模糊。漫射侧光透过薄表面发亮，而非产生坚硬镜面光。阴影在重叠处保持温和；背景只有几乎察觉不到的色彩漂移，没有明确环境。整体效果安静而可触，由通透留白、选择性清晰度和冷色透明层与微小暖高光的交换塑造。
theme_en: Two delicate blue flowers with golden stamens against a soft gray background
theme_zh: 两朵带金色花蕊的纤薄蓝花立于柔灰背景前
name: Mandy Disher
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
